thread:
olga_cs: Heads-up: LighthouseAI is running a combined EMEA+APAC partner demo next week and staging is hitting token/rate throttles. They asked for a temporary regional split bump (eu-central-1 + ap-northeast-1), CIDR allowlist, and an SNI hostname allow so their proxy TLS passthrough doesn't get rejected. Renewal review in ~7 days, this demo is a make-or-break.

devon_infra: Ok — can you paste exact window, IPs (v4/v6), and model slug? Also whether they want traffic split % between regions or simple geo pinning.

olga_cs: Owner: nate@lighthouse.ai. Window: 2026-04-10T20:00Z -> 2026-04-14T20:00Z (96h). Peak qps ~3200, steady ~1800. CIDRs: 54.231.0.0/18 and IPv6 2600:1f18:abcd::/48. SNI hostname: demo.sni.lighthouse.ai. Prefer geo-split with 60% eu-central-1 / 40% ap-northeast-1. Model: light/launcher-v2 (staging). They also asked to enable prefix caching and sticky routing for session affinity.

devon_infra: That peak is significant but doable with split burst pools. I'll open an ops ticket to reserve capacity and add proxy + SNI allow rules. We'll limit the grant to the demo model slug and those CIDRs/SNI only.

mira_se: I'll pre-warm top-20 prompt prefixes in both regions, set batch_max_tokens=768, concurrency=32, and enable prefix_cache TTL=900s. I'll also create geo-weighted canary routes and a smoke harness to assert kv_cache_hits and p95 latency.

ops-bot: @devon_infra created ticket OPS-6410: "LighthouseAI EMEA+APAC demo split-burst, CIDR+SNI allow". Approval SLA: 2h. Link: https://redwood.ops/OPS-6410

devon_infra: Note: need infra change to allow TLS SNI header through proxy for demo.sni.lighthouse.ai. Also will add both IPv4 + IPv6 to proxy allowlist. Planning estimated uplift ~$2.6k for 96h across two regions.

deploy-bot: Canary deployments queued: canary/light-launcher-v2-warm-eu -> eu-central-1; canary/light-launcher-v2-warm-ap -> ap-northeast-1. ETA ~22m.

mira_se: Small snag during warm: our proxy rejected the SNI on the first attempt due to missing passthrough rule (TLS-TERM bypass). I updated proxy config to allow SNI passthrough for demo.sni.lighthouse.ai and re-ran warm.

devon_infra: Thanks — updated OPS-6410 with change log. Canary logs show: "kv_cache_hits=96% , p95_latency=190ms (eu), 210ms (ap)". Burst pools reserved with geo-split 60/40, auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-04-14T20:10Z.

olga_cs: Can you include the CLI snippet I can paste to confirm CIDR entries in their firewall? Their infra team asked for a quick command.

devon_infra: Sure — use internal proxy CLI: ```redwood-proxy allow-add --cidr 54.231.0.0/18 --cidr 2600:1f18:abcd::/48 --sni demo.sni.lighthouse.ai --ticket OPS-6410```

olga_cs: Perfect, sending to Nate. Sylvia (AE) I'll flag the ~$2.6k uplift in renewal notes; if demo succeeds we should push as momentum.

sylvia_ae: Noted. If they ask to extend past auto-revoke, I'll prepare amendment language and pricing.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed successfully to both regions. Warm logs: "eu: kv_cache_hits=96%, ap: kv_cache_hits=95%".

devon_infra: OPS-6410 updated: CIDRs (54.231.0.0/18, 2600:1f18:abcd::/48) + SNI demo.sni.lighthouse.ai added to proxy allowlist; burst pools allocated eu-central-1 (60%) / ap-northeast-1 (40%); model slug limited; auto-revoke at 2026-04-14T20:10Z. Estimated cost uplift ~$2.6k. Rollback steps documented.

mira_se: Ran smoke at 08:45 local and full demo run at 09:15 SGT. p95 latencies within SLO, no errors.

olga_cs: Customer confirmed demo success and sent recording. AE @sylvia_ae capturing in renewal playbook. Thanks team — this was high-impact.

devon_infra: Closing OPS-6410 as done. We'll auto-revoke per schedule; ping here if they ask to extend.

olga_cs: Closing: renewal flagged as positive momentum. :rocket:
